resources.string: Connect your headset in Android Bluetooth settings. Tap its route button below, then open ChatGPT and test with the phone several metres away.\n\nAndroid and ChatGPT can override this request. Compare the headset microphone with routing on and off. Stop routing after testing; headset call mode can reduce playback quality.
Grant Nearby devices permission to select a headset.
No SCO/HFP or BLE headset communication device is available. Connect a headset that supports calls, then refresh.
